name: RetroPC Storage R8 custom SPI NOR card
coordinateSystem: x right, y down as KiCad PCB, z up; board top0; world coordinates
status: Historical unfinished R8 checkpoint. Custom 22×80 mm M-key-form SPI NOR card, 64 MiB raw across four GD25Q128ESIGR chips. NOT NVMe, SATA or PCIe compatible. Routing checkpoint only; no fabrication, firmware, analog or connector-fit qualification. Library package meshes, not vendor CAD.
